name: Pinball Arcade: Fathom
storyline: Fathom (1980) is a classic table designed by Ward Pemberton with art by Greg Freres. This beautiful table plunges players into the waters of a deep lagoon infested with vicious sea nymphs. Free the Balls locked in the Cave and lagoon for double or triple Playfield scoring. Dive down the reversed Return Lanes, set outside the Outlanes. Shoot the 1-2-3 Targets, in order, to light the Hurry-Up Extra Ball. And build your dual Bonuses, each with their own multiplier. Danger, sea nymphs await, in Fathom! 3,500 units were produced.
